title: Ample line bundles from projective embeddings
statement:
Let $k$ be a field, let $i:X\hookrightarrow\mathbf{P}^n_k$ be a closed immersion
and let $\mathcal{L}:=i^*\mathcal{O}_{\mathbf{P}^n}(1)$. Then $\mathcal{L}$ is
ample on $X$; in particular the base change
$\mathcal{L}\otimes_k K$ is ample on $X_K$ for every field extension $K/k$.

proof.text: The closed immersion $i:X\to\mathbf P^n_k$ makes $X$ projective over $k$, hence proper over $k$ [lem-pc-projective-proper]. This supplies the properness hypothesis of the affine-locus criterion used in step 3.

source.place: Morphisms, projective morphisms are proper (projective-proper); applied to the closed immersion into projective space

proof.text: Let $T_0,\ldots,T_n$ be the coordinate sections of $\mathcal O_{\mathbf P^n_k}(1)$ and put $s_j=i^*T_j\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal L)$, using the given isomorphism $i^*\mathcal O(1)\cong\mathcal L$. By [lem-weil-pbc-projective-space-standard-charts] (a),(b), the $D_+(T_j)$ cover $\mathbf P^n_k$ and $X_{s_j}=i^{-1}(D_+(T_j))$. Each $D_+(T_j)$ is affine by (c) with base $\operatorname{Spec}k$. The restriction of the closed immersion $i$ over this affine chart is a closed immersion, and its source is affine by [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-affine-cover-criterion] (1) (equivalently Schemes 01IH). Thus the finitely many affine $X_{s_j}$ cover $X$.

For every $x\in X$ step 2 gives an index $j$ with $x\in X_{s_j}$ and $X_{s_j}$ affine. Apply [lem-pc-ample-affine-loci-criterion] with exponent $1$ to the proper scheme from step 1. It yields ampleness in the exact sense of [def-sc-ample].

For a field extension $K/k$ write $p:X_K\to X$ for the projection and $i_K:X_K\to\mathbf P^n_K$ for the base change of $i$ [def-pc-base-change]. It is a closed immersion by [lem-pc-closed-imm-base-change]. The projective space and its $\mathcal O(1)$ are obtained by pullback from $\mathbf P^n_{\mathbf Z}$ [lem-weil-pbc-projective-space-standard-charts]; hence the canonical composition isomorphism for module pullback [lem-weil-pbc-invertible-pullback-tensor] (2) identifies $p^*i^*\mathcal O_{\mathbf P^n_k}(1)$ with $i_K^*\mathcal O_{\mathbf P^n_K}(1)$. Under the given $i^*\mathcal O(1)\cong\mathcal L$, its left side is the stated $\mathcal L\otimes_kK=p^*\mathcal L$. Apply steps 1-3 over $K$ to $i_K$ and this isomorphism to conclude that $p^*\mathcal L$ is ample on $X_K$.

Corrected its unsupported assertion that finitely many affine nonvanishing loci themselves form a basis. The criterion is isolated as a new unsplit node, sourced through Stacks 01PS and 01VU.

tool_uses.why: The projective-proper lemma supplies properness of X; this unit has no proof of projective-proper.
The chart theorem supplies the cover, O(1) sections, and their nonvanishing loci; these are generic projective-space facts.
Its affine restriction clause supplies the affineness of each closed subscheme of a standard affine chart.
Its pullback composition clause identifies the base-changed twisting sheaf with O(1) on projective space over K.
